statement.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] {A : Set X},
  IsClosed (closure Aᶜ) →
    ∀ {f : X → Y}, ContinuousOn f A → ∀ (g : X → Y), ContinuousOn g A → Set.EqOn f g (closure Aᶜ) → Set.EqOn f g A

comparison.candUnfolded:
∀ {X : Type u_0} {Y : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] {A : Set X},
  IsClosed (closure Aᶜ) →
    ∀ {f : X → Y}, ContinuousOn f A → ∀ (g : X → Y), ContinuousOn g A → Set.EqOn f g (closure Aᶜ) → Set.EqOn f g A
comparison.refUnfolded:
∀ {X : Type u_0} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] {Y : Type u_1} [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] {A : Set X}
  {f : X → Y},
  ContinuousOn f A →
    ∀ (g : X → Y),
      ContinuousOn g (closure A) →
        (∀ (x : ↑A), g ↑x = f ↑x) →
          ∀ (g' : X → Y), (ContinuousOn g' (closure A) ∧ ∀ (x : ↑A), g' ↑x = f ↑x) → ∀ (x : ↑(closure A)), g ↑x = g' ↑x
